headline.text: L1 S2 on hold for *foreign material* in almonds — fiber resembling insect larvae found at 02:23, all pallets from 02:00 onward isolated, line cleaning in progress.

summary: One active food-safety hold at L1 S2: possible insect larvae in almonds, investigation and cleaning underway. L1 S2 metal detector rejection system failed when air supply shut off — detected but did not reject test cards, timeline under investigation. Two belt delamination events (L1 S3, L2 ML2) caught and corrected before product impact.

holds.title: Almond cluster line — foreign material hold
holds.summary: Gray/tan fuzzy fiber resembling insect larvae found in almond at 02:23; additional pallets from different lots inspected and found similar material; all finished product pallets from 02:00 onward placed on hold pending investigation completion.
holds.status: Investigation ongoing — production halted at 04:24, allergy clean initiated, melting tanks emptied by 07:10.

food_safety.title: S2 metal detector rejection system failure
food_safety.summary: Air supply to rejection mechanism shut off between 06:15 (3rd shift passed test cards) and 07:28 (1st shift startup); system detected test cards correctly but did not physically open reject gate; unknown when shutdown occurred or if production ran during failure.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance restored air supply and verified correct operation; investigating timeline of failure and whether production occurred without functional rejection.

food_safety.title: S3 food-contact belt delaminating
food_safety.summary: C22 belt (jar filling conveyor system) has parts peeling and delaminating; maintenance replacing belt; potential for belt material fragments to enter product zone during failure period.
food_safety.status: Resolved — belt removed at 10:57, new belt installed, will be retested for ATP and allergen verification post-installation.

food_safety.title: ML2 double-belt delamination
food_safety.summary: Drive-side double belt on cooling tunnel peeling and separating; maintenance advised cleaning area to prevent jams; belt removed and replaced with new unit.
food_safety.status: Resolved — old belt removed at 06:01, new belt cleaned and passed ATP at 06:12, installed and line restarted at 06:51.

quality.title: ML2 caramel agitator stopped
quality.summary: Agitator in caramel tank not spinning; potentiometer knob stuck internally; could affect caramel consistency and viscosity if undetected for extended period.
quality.status: Resolved — maintenance cleared stuck knob, agitator restored to operation within 8 minutes.

allergen.title: Truffle line WIP labeling for V3 film transition
allergen.summary: QA flagged need to label all sides of WIP pallets containing V3 film product to ensure correct allergen-statement film version is used during final packaging; preventive control for allergen label accuracy.
allergen.status: Resolved — labeling protocol implemented on shift for V3 WIP pallets.

opportunities.text: Consider adding metal detector air-supply status to startup checklist or installing a pressure alarm — based on S2 rejection-system failure that went undetected between 3rd shift close (06:15) and 1st shift startup (07:28).
Review food-contact belt inspection frequency and replacement criteria — based on S3 C22 belt delamination discovered mid-shift, echoing similar belt failure at L2 ML2 today.
Review food-contact belt inspection frequency and replacement criteria — based on ML2 double-belt delamination on drive side that required emergency replacement during production.
